title: THREE LOST FINALS, ONE BALLON D'OR: KANE STILL WANTS THE BIG ONE
description:
Fifth in ESPN's November top ten, and still the Ballon d'Or winner. Awkward.

Kane still wants a big trophy, and the Champions League is the big goal. He lost the 2019 final to Liverpool, two-nil. Then Euro 2020. Then Euro 2024. A very shiny silver collection.

Bayern paid a reported 120 million euros. Uli Hoeness called it crazy, then said he would have paid 150. Crazy became cheap.

Asked about a knighthood, Kane wouldn't turn one down, but 'Sir' would feel odd. A Patriots quarterback says he could be an NFL kicker; Kane says Bayern come first. ESPN's list puts him behind Yamal, Bellingham, Olise and Raphinha.

Champions League or a knighthood: which would you want for Kane? Choose one.
